The densest seams are Chapter 9's per-architect project lists (printed pp. 211-290), Appendix B's table of additional Modern architects, Appendix D's Docomomo inventory, and Thomas D. Church's residential garden list. Appendix C, William Wurster's client list, carries almost no addresses and its entries are client names.
